claims.text: Ongoing mgmt (AVRT and/or pre-excited AF, ablation ⍉an option): oral flecainide or propafenone = reasonable if ⍉struct or ischemic Hdz;
claims.quote: Oral flecainide or propafenone is reasonable for ongoing management in patients without structural heart disease or ischemic heart disease who have AVRT and/or pre-excited AF and are not candidates for, or prefer not to undergo, catheter ablation.

claims.text: oral dofetilide or sotalol may be reasonable.
claims.quote: Oral dofetilide or sotalol may be reasonable for ongoing management in patients with AVRT and/or pre-excited AF who are not candidates for, or prefer not to undergo, catheter ablation.

claims.text: Unlike flecainide and propafenone, sotalol and dofetilide can be used w struct Hdz or CAD.
claims.quote: Unlike flecainide and propafenone, sotalol and dofetilide can be used in patients with structural heart disease or coronary artery disease
